Cc=1 pF with gm1 of about 110 uS gives GBW of about 17 MHz. gm6 of about 480 uS is more than 4x gm1*CL/Cc, which supports PM >55 deg. A 20 uA tail with 1 pF Cc gives SR of 20 V/us. I6=60 uA into Cc+CL gives 20 V/us. The diode sits on the vinn side, so vinp is non-inverting."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),       # input pair L
    "Itail": (20e-6, 12e-6, 50e-6),  # tail current
    "gmidp": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror / 2nd-stage gm/Id (same density -> low offset)
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS L (mirror and M6)
    "I6":    (60e-6, 30e-6, 150e-6), # 2nd-stage current
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.5, 0.8, 4.0),        # Rz = rzk / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    Id1 = It / 2
    gmidn = 12.0  # NMOS sources: vdsat ~0.15 V keeps tail in saturation at VCM=0.9

    # input pair (source ~0.2 V -> vsb ~0.2)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Id1, vds=abs(lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Id1).vgs))
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Id1, vds=m3.vgs)
    # 2nd stage PMOS CS (same gm/Id, L as mirror -> zero systematic offset)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias / tail / load
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref).vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.2)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    gm6 = m6.gm
    Rz = p["rzk"] / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)     # vinp side drives output node x
    n.dev("M2", "d", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)     # vinn side has the diode
    n.dev("M3", "d", "d", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm6 / (2 * PI * (cl + c1 + cl * c1 / Cc))
    pm_mirror = gm6 / gm6 * m3.gm / (2 * PI * (m3.cgg + m4.cgg))  # mirror pole
    # LHP zero from Rz > 1/gm6
    wz = 1.0 / (Cc * (1.0 / gm6 - Rz)) if abs(Rz - 1.0 / gm6) > 1e-3 / gm6 else -1e30
    zero_term = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(wz / (2 * PI)))) if wz < 0 else -math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw * 2 * PI / wz))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror)) \
         + 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (pm_mirror * 2))) + zero_term
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (Cc + cl))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": 1.8 * (iref + It + I6)}
```
